killer.title: Carbon copy of revised minutes
killer.content: A carbon copy of meeting minutes has a paragraph about the victim's dismissal crossed out and rewritten in a different hand.

killer.title: Marked staff roster
killer.content: A staff roster bears pencil marks beside the victim's name and two late shifts.

killer.title: Unsent grievance
killer.content: A draft grievance complains that a promotion was promised privately and withdrawn in front of the office.

killer.title: Office key receipt
killer.content: A receipt records a replacement key ordered after a disagreement about who could enter the records room.

killer.title: Torn meeting agenda
killer.content: A torn agenda lists a closed meeting on the day the victim was removed from a committee.

killer.title: Carbon-stained memo
killer.content: A memo refers to a missing personnel folder and asks that the matter be settled before the next review.

killer.title: Unclaimed desk nameplate
killer.content: A company nameplate bearing the victim's surname is wrapped in newspaper and kept in a cupboard.

killer.title: Marked office calendar
killer.content: An office calendar has the victim's last scheduled shift crossed through and replaced with another name.

victim.title: Folded office memorandum
victim.content: A memorandum about a disputed dismissal is folded into a personal notebook. The margin carries a second set of initials.

victim.title: Private salary calculation
victim.content: A penciled calculation compares two salaries and circles a figure that does not match the latest pay statement.

victim.title: Unsent appeal
victim.content: A draft appeal asks for a personnel decision to be reviewed before the end of the month.

victim.title: Marked staff roster
victim.content: A staff roster bears a question mark beside a colleague assigned to the victim's last shift.

victim.title: Meeting reminder
victim.content: A reminder requests a private meeting about the victim's work record. No room is specified.

victim.title: Photostat of a warning
victim.content: A photostat copy of a company warning is annotated with the words 'not my initials'.

victim.title: Desk inventory list
victim.content: A list of office property returned by the victim includes one missing ledger and a brass cabinet key.

victim.title: Torn appointment card
victim.content: An appointment card for a meeting with a supervisor has its time torn away.

colleague.title: Revised duty roster
colleague.content: A roster dated 15 October moves one clerk from the morning ledger desk to the evening registry window.

colleague.title: Damaged typewriter ribbon
colleague.content: A company inventory slip records a replacement ribbon issued on 16 October after a jam during the afternoon shift.

colleague.title: Disputed requisition copy
colleague.content: A carbon requisition for ledger paper bears two different initials and the date 14 October.

colleague.title: Union notice clipping
colleague.content: A clipping from the staff notice board records a meeting at the company hall on 12 October, 20:00.

associate.title: Repair estimate
associate.content: A cobbler's estimate for a repaired left heel is dated 13 October; collection was marked for the following day.

associate.title: Laundry claim tag
associate.content: A laundry tag numbered 62 lists a dark coat received on 15 October, with the return signature missing.

associate.title: Shared lending note
associate.content: A note dated 10 October records a borrowed book due back after the Sunday bell service.

associate.title: Apothecary receipt
associate.content: A receipt for soothing balm is stamped 16 October at 17:10; the purchaser name is abbreviated.
